title: Hockey night
setting: She texts after her team wins in overtime.

exchanges.theirMessage: OT winner!! Power play goal, we finally got the man advantage.

replies.text: Nice, the power play finally clicked?
replies.coachNote: You picked up the term and asked about it.

replies.theirResponse: ...We did. It is in my text.

closingNote: A power play is a two-minute man advantage after a penalty.
